split_rule: 1-degree blocks SHA256 geofm-external-v1, 60/20/20 with 5km cross-split guard
radiometry: source DN / 10000; L1C to L2A/HLS domain shift retained
known_limits: External dataset track, Europe, source image labels; not new sensor observations or proven absent from checkpoint pretraining.

prior_identity_audit.rule: Exact blue-green-red DN pixels or per-band sorted pixels, followed by 5km exclusion around original-source centres.
